cells.quote: The result of the interaction effect is significant (Wilks’ Lambda = 0.72, p <  .05). This shows that there is an interaction effect between cooperative TGT and the conventional approach towards the MU test. Interaction effect is a type of disordinal interaction because the teaching using cooperative TGT had increased MU and this relationship was positive (pre to post-1). Whereas using conventional teaching had shown a decline in MU and the relationship is negative (post-1 to post-2) (Hair, Anderson, Tatham, & Black, 1998).
cells.note: Posttest 1 followed five weeks of Cooperative TGT; posttest 2 followed a further five-week withdrawal phase.
